label: Hashabiah

text.BHSA 1CH 9:13: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם רָאשִׁים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹותָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות וְשִׁשִּׁ֑ים גִּבֹּ֣ורֵי חֵ֔יל מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבֹודַ֥ת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
text.KJV 1CH 9:13: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
text.BHSA 1CH 9:14: וּמִֽן־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה בֶן־חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן־עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה מִן־בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי׃
text.KJV 1CH 9:14: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
text.BHSA 1CH 9:15: וּבַקְבַּקַּ֥ר חֶ֖רֶשׁ וְגָלָ֑ל וּמַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן־מִיכָ֔א בֶּן־זִכְרִ֖י בֶּן־אָסָֽף׃
text.KJV 1CH 9:15: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

A.name: Hashabiah
A.line: son of Amaziah (1CH 6:45), Levite during the return (NEH 10:11, NEH 12:24)
A.notes: Merarites (from Mushi, from Merari, son of Levi)
family: son-of amaziah-the-merarite (Amaziah, son of Hilkiah, in the line of Ethan the Merarite singer (1C)

B.name: Hashabiah
B.line: Son of Bunni, father of Azrikam, ancestor of Shemaiah in Nehemiah's day

why: The Hebrew gives the Merarite ancestry Shemaiah–Hasshub–Azrikam–Hashabiah, matching B’s stated identity as Shemaiah’s ancestor. The identification is not conclusive from this verse alone, since Hashabiah’s father is unnamed and A also claims to be Azrikam’s father.
